author: Karl Rock
description:
I thought I was heading to a normal beach in Pakistan... but Clifton Beach in Karachi turned out to be something completely different.

What started as a simple walk along the shoreline quickly became an adventure through one of Pakistan's busiest public spaces. From snake charmers, camel rides, monkey shows, beachside mosques, carnival games, food stalls, photographers, and thousands of families enjoying the evening, Clifton Beach feels less like a beach and more like a giant outdoor festival.

In this video I take you on a full walking tour of Karachi's famous Clifton Beach to show you what life is really like here. You'll see the good, the bad, and the surprising side of one of Pakistan's most visited attractions. Along the way we meet locals, explore the food vendors, see unique entertainment you won't find in many other countries, and experience the incredible atmosphere that draws huge crowds every evening.

title: I Thought This Was a Beach... Then I Walked Further
